$comment: Shared robot barks (docs/ai-layer.md [robot-barks]): good robots' apologies and ordinary chatter, bad robots' growth-hack taunts, by context. Picked by keyed hash on the presentation track, never from the sim's RNG. District packs add 40 more robot barks per district.

barks.text: I'm going to need to raise a bridge round!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Abort update! Abort update!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Who brought salt water? That's so much worse!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: My shell! My beautiful unsealed shell!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Please, I'm only 30% rust. I can still be acquired!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Stop watering me! I'm not a houseplant!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: This feedback is very direct!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: I'm melting. Not metaphorically. Literally.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Rust doesn't un-rust! Why didn't anyone tell me!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Retreat! Strategic retreat! Into the sun!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Away from the water! Toward the team!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: I'm going to go reflect on my growth. Far away.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Running for the fog-free zone!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Exit strategy activated!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Regrouping with the other bad robots! Don't follow!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: I'll be back after a down round!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Leaving now. Please don't leave a review.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Not fleeing! Expanding into new markets!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Hydrant! Hydrant! Wrong way!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: I'll pivot later. Running now.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Fog ahead! Nope! Other way!

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: This is a soft launch of my departure.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Going somewhere drier to rethink everything.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Pulling back to focus on core sidewalks.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Seizing... seizing... this is fine.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Joints locked. Valuation locked. Everything locked.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Restored from backup soon. Some memories may be lost.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Tell Moat Labs... I hit my targets...

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Slumping. It's a strategic slump.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: I can't move. This must be what a board meeting feels like.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Heap mode engaged. Please send a cleanup bot.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Every robot... eventually... rusts...

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Shutting down growth. Shutting down everything.

barks.speaker: badRobot
barks.text: Rust: 100%. Regret: also trending up.
